text:
Alex Kim: Hey payroll team — I moved from CA to OR on 2026-02-12. On 2026-02-26 my paycheck shows the $60/month internet stipend and $450 one-time desk reimbursement taxed as wages. I thought stipends were usually non-taxable when paid under an accountable plan. Also my state tax shows CA withholding still. Can someone confirm next steps? :wave:

Payroll Bot: Thanks Alex! Filing ticket #PAY-4721. Please attach receipts and the home office form: https://concur.company/expense. (auto) :robot_face:

HR Ops: Hi Alex — quick answers: 1) Reimbursements can be non-taxable if submitted under the accountable plan with receipts and a business purpose within 60 days. 2) Internet stipend may be treated as taxable de minimis if no receipts; otherwise ok under accountable plan. 3) State withholding follows the legal address on file at payroll cutoff. If you updated address after cutoff we may need an off-cycle. :information_source:

Alex Kim: I submitted receipts and the home-office attestation yesterday and updated my Workday address on 2026-02-20. Ticket says payroll taxed them already — any chance for correction?

Payroll: Thanks for the receipts — I see them on the ticket. Because the taxable event hit the Feb 26 payroll, we can either (a) issue an off-cycle correction to reclassify the reimbursements as non-taxable and adjust payroll taxes, or (b) leave as-is and do a year-end W-2 adjustment if material. Off-cycle correction requires approval from Finance and usually takes 7-10 business days. Which do you prefer? :thinking_face:

Alex Kim: Off-cycle please if possible — the desk was $450, would push my tax burden high this quarter.

Sophie Chen: FWIW, when we ran a similar case in Jan, off-cycle worked fine. Finance usually approves for >$300.

HR Ops: OK marking as off-cycle request in #PAY-4721 and escalating to Finance. Can you reconfirm the reimbursement vendor and date? Also we'll switch state withholding to OR effective 2026-02-20, but note the Feb 26 pay already withheld CA. We'll need to file a correction to refund the CA withholding and withhold OR instead.

Alex Kim: Vendor: IKEA invoice 2026-02-15, receipt attached in ticket. Confirm OR effective date 2026-02-20.

Payroll: Got it. Submitted off-cycle job to reclassify $450 and re-run state withholding corrections. Finance approval requested — if approved, you'll see a reversal line and net refund on the off-cycle check in ~7 business days. We'll DM when approved. :thumbsup:

Alex Kim: Thanks team! Appreciate the help.

Payroll Bot: Ticket #PAY-4721 updated: status = Escalated to Finance. Please allow 7-10 business days. If you need immediate cash, reach out to payroll for a manual advance. :calendar:

Sophie Chen: tagging @FinanceOps for awareness. :eyes:

FinanceOps: Received escalation, reviewing now. Expected response by 2026-03-02.
